independent_review.review: independent read-only native review of the sealed eight-case borrow-invalidation candidate

findings.finding: The valid case transaction 4 commits with 22 fields in both baseline and candidate, but candidate timing is 7,814,376 clocks versus 7,814,280 baseline clocks (+96). The strict gate rejects on CASE_TRANSACTION_CLOCK_REGRESSION:valid:4. This is a successful-transaction regression, so the candidate is not promotable under the current gate.

The early case aborted transaction 3 also regresses by 76 clocks (9,055,984 candidate versus 9,055,908 baseline) at the same 25 fields. It is a separate rollback-path regression; the captured milestones show the +76 persisting through rollback completion and rejection.

unresolved_review_gaps: The valid transaction 4 milestone comparison establishes the +96-clock drift but does not isolate it to one opcode or subroutine.

A first RIGHT startup attempt timed out at 9 of 10 requested frames while polling cold-to-title before the borrowed-home workload. A fresh RIGHT retry passed, but the cause of the first timeout remains unproven. Exact frame assertions and timeout policy were not relaxed.
The top-level candidate PASS receipt is intentionally absent. The retained native rejection states that all raw seals were verified before rejection and no top-level PASS was written.
remaining_product_gaps: This candidate experiment demonstrates the scoped borrowed-home invalidation path and its measured cases; it does not establish complete game behavior, 30 FPS production performance, audio, combat, HUD, or production concurrency.
limitations: Read-only review only. No emulator was started; no captures were modified, resealed, or recollected; no source was changed. The prior seven-case raw-file hashes and the final eight-case pinned raw manifest were checked as separate integrity constraints.

inherited_correctness_receipt.scope: Inherited correctness/older optimization gates; not current all-transaction acceptance.

remaining_gaps: Successful restoration transaction4 timing drift is not corrected.
